ministry_of_infr.notification_of_the_com: Files a new intake record for a bus terminal that has no fuel dispensing equipment, submitting the start-of-operations notice via the MoIT portal and returning the registration reference number and status.

Registers a bus terminal lacking a refueling unit as ready for service and returns the signed activation certificate issued by the MOIT transport licensing unit. Use the terminal ID from the operator's filing to fetch the stamped record.

Settles the registration fee for an MCT-IBS-NOTIFY filing: charges the payer for a new intercity coach terminal opening, excluding fuel dispensing equipment, and returns the payment receipt reference and amount due.
Files a new commencement-of-operation declaration for a covered vehicle park with the Ministry's infrastructure registry and returns the submission reference number and status.

Retrieves the closing certificate issued by MOIT once a covered vehicle bay has been cleared for public use. Returns the signed go-live record for the facility, including site reference, capacity and effective date.
Pays the filing fee for a sheltered parking facility start-up notice via the IT department's MOIT-SPF payment gateway, and returns the payment receipt reference and status.
ministry_of_tour.notification_of_the_com: Registers a new filing or update for a pool-site licence at a lodging property. Submits the start-up or amendment record for a guest-facility aquatic unit and returns a reference ID with the processing status.
Registers a pool-opening or pool-details update for lodging premises and returns the signed compliance receipt issued by the Ministry Of Tourism's aquatic facilities unit.

Processes the fee payment for pool-facility registration filings at tourist lodgings, including new pool openings and updates to existing pool records. Returns the payment receipt and transaction reference.
ministry_of_infr.notification_of_the_com: Files a new application for the launch of a freight depot (Type A) concession site: registers the operator's start-up notice for cargo handling yards and returns a submission reference number with its processing status.
Registers the go-live of a type-A freight terminal under concession and returns the signed activation certificate issued once the filing is accepted.
Processes the fee payment for the freight terminal go-live filing (Category A) under a concession arrangement, and returns the payment receipt and reference number.
ministry_of_deve.notification_of_the_est: Files a new registration for a food and drink retail outlet under health-code Class III, submitting the operator's details and premises data and returning a submission receipt with a reference number.
Generates the registration certificate for a food and drink retail outlet under the Ministry of Development's health-compliance workflow, returning the issued permit file with its reference number.

Submits a new filing for opening or running a health-regulated retail outlet, such as a barbershop, beauty salon, or tattoo studio, and returns the registration reference number and status of the filing.

Retrieves the issued sign-off certificate for a registered hygiene-compliant business unit, confirming that its launch and trading have been formally logged with the ministry's health-licensing registry.
Processes the payment of the filing fee for a health-related business licence application, returning the payment confirmation and reference number.
Submits a new venue-opening declaration to the Ministry of Development's licensing system for a performance hall or screening room, and returns the registration reference number and intake status.

Retrieves the final issued permit document for a venue licence application, covering the approval of a new performing-arts or screening venue. Returns the signed approval letter with its reference number and date.
ministry_of_infr.notification_of_the_ope: Submits a new service-activity filing for a vehicle servicing bay (cars, motorcycles, mopeds) to the ministry's workshop registry, and returns the registration ID and acknowledgement status.
Registers a repair shop's notice of operation for vehicle servicing (cars, motorcycles, mopeds) and returns the issued registration certificate.
Processes the fee payment for the workshop operating-permit filing for vehicle repair garages (cars, motorcycles, mopeds) and returns the payment confirmation and receipt reference.
ministry_of_tour.notification_of_the_ope: Submits a new filing for a tourism road carrier registration: captures operator details, fleet data and route plans, then returns a tracking reference and the current review status of the submission.
Registers a tourist transport operator's start-up filing with the Ministry's transport licensing unit and returns the signed acknowledgment receipt issued once the filing is accepted.
Settles the levy for registering a tourist coach and charter vehicle operator with the ministry; returns the payment receipt reference and the amount charged.
ministry_of_citi.operating_licence_for_a: Submits a new application for a sole-trader security provider permit through the MCP-PSE gateway, returning the assigned case reference and the list of outstanding documents still required from the applicant.

Registers a sole-trader security provider's permit application and returns the issued authorization certificate, using the MCP-PSV internal workflow code (Ministry of Citizen Protection, private guard/ops licensing).

Settles the levy for the sole-trader security provider permit file (MCP-SPF-PAY). Takes the applicant's registration ID and file reference, then returns the payment receipt and the updated status of the fee on the case.
ministry_of_mari.renewal_of_a_licence_to: Submits a fast-vessel operating permit renewal request to the ministry's coastal registry and returns a tracking reference with the expected review status.

Retrieves the permit issued after a fast passenger vessel operating authorization is extended, generated by the MMAIP vessel licensing unit (VLU-HSC). Returns the renewed certificate document for the craft.
Settles the levy for the fast-vessel operating permit extension: submits the payment against a permit reference and returns the receipt ID and the amount charged.
ministry_for_cli.temporary_active_fire_p: Files a new application for a temporary fire-safety permit through the local fire prevention and suppression office, submitting the applicant's site and event details. Returns the registration reference number and the current processing status of the submitted request.

Generates the interim fire-readiness clearance (TFR permit) issued by the local fire prevention and suppression unit of the Climate & Civil Protection Ministry, confirming a site's temporary active fire safeguards are operational. Returns the signed clearance sheet with its validity window and reference number.

Processes the payment of the fee for a temporary fire safety permit issued by the local fire prevention and suppression department. Returns the payment confirmation, transaction reference and the amount charged, so the applicant can attach proof of payment to the file.
ministry_of_infr.vehicle_technical_inspe: Submits a new cross-border vehicle roadworthiness assessment request (or declaration) to the MOIT inspection registry and returns the application reference number, status, and expected processing timeline.

Retrieves the closing certificate issued by the MOIT vehicle roadworthiness unit once a foreign-registered vehicle has been cleared for temporary operation in the country; returns the certificate reference, validity dates and inspection outcome.
gov_gr.solemn_declaration_and_electro_gr: Submits a new sworn statement (affidavit-style declaration) to the Gov.gr portal on behalf of the citizen, both on paper-based and digital channels, and returns the registered declaration ID and submission timestamp.
Generates the signed affidavit receipt (Υπεύθυνη Δήλωση) for citizens' statements submitted through the gov.gr portal, returning the stamped PDF with its submission reference number and timestamp.
courts.single_certificate_of_judicial_gr: Files a new solvency attestation request for the courts registry and returns the submission reference ID and current review status. Uses the internal CRT-SOLV intake workflow, so applicants can track their filing without referencing the statutory form name.
Generates the court's SCJS-DOC record confirming a party's clearance of outstanding fines, fees, and filing balances, and returns the signed clearance statement for the requesting litigant.
ministry_of_just.copy_of_criminal_record: Submits a new request to the MoJ Penal Registry Desk (PRD) for a certified extract of a person's conviction history, and returns the request reference number and expected processing date.
Retrieves the MoJ conduct certificate (police-check extract) for a citizen: queries the central offender register and returns the signed, stamped summary of any convictions on file.
fire_service.certificate_of_active_fire_: Submits a new FP-cert request or self-declaration through the FSD intake portal and returns the reference ID and current review status for the filing.

Fetches the fire safety compliance letter for a premises: pulls the inspection record from the FS permits database and returns the signed clearance notice the department issues once a site passes its safety walkthrough.
other_public_bod.authorisation_and_elect: Submits a new request or declaration to the department's approval workflow and returns a tracking reference for the filing.

Retrieves the signed approval certificate generated when a user's access request clears the internal sign-off workflow, returning the PDF record with the approver's e-signature and the grant reference number.
e_efka.social_security_clearance_of_n_gr: Submits a new E-Efka compliance request for a person or company, forwarding the applicant's details to the central filing queue and returning a request reference number and its current processing status.

Retrieves the issued compliance certificate for a taxpayer or company from the E-Efka insurance records system. Given an identifier (AFM or AMKA), it returns the signed status document confirming contribution payments are up to date.
other_public_bod.decision_approving_envi: Submits a new request or notice to the EnvCon portal for Category A works, returning the generated submission reference and current review status.
Fetches the final sign-off notice issued when an environmental clearance review for minor-tier projects closes, returning the stamped approval letter with its attached compliance conditions.
independent_auth.certificate_of_no_outst: Submits a new clearance request to the revenue body's taxpayer ledger and returns the reference ID of the filed clearance record, confirming the taxpayer's account standing as of the filing date.

Fetches the clearance statement confirming a taxpayer has settled all dues, generated by the revenue office's compliance module (CM-ClearDoc). Returns the signed PDF letter with the taxpayer's reference number and issue date.
other_public_bod.myphoto_for_citizens_gr: Submits a new citizen image-ID enrolment request (portrait upload plus applicant details) to the department's identity-photo registry and returns a tracking reference and processing status.

Retrieves the citizen ID-photo credential generated at the close of the enrollment workflow, returning the signed photo card record (portrait reference, card number, validity date) for the requesting resident.
other_public_bod.authorisation_for_the_o: Submits a new filing for an LPG or mixed-gas fuel outlet operating permit tied to a site concession, using our department's intake workflow. Returns the generated case reference and current queue status for the applicant.

Generates the permit for an LPG or mixed-gas fuel point under a concession-based site agreement, using our internal dept wording. Returns the signed operating licence document issued at the close of the workflow.
ministry_of_envi.operating_licence_for_a: Submits a new filing for a fuel-dispensing site authorisation, covering compressed natural gas outlets and combined fuel sites under a land-use grant, and returns a registration ID with the current review status.

Generates the final authorization certificate for a compressed natural gas refuelling facility, including combined gas-and-fuel sites, once the establishment concession has been granted. Returns the signed permit document that allows the site to start commercial operation.
e_efka.social_security_contributions__gr: Submits a new request to the e-EFKA portal on behalf of a taxpayer and returns the registration number and status of the filing. Use it to lodge a fresh application or declaration with the IT department's internal workflow (EFKA-APP), which queues the request and reports back its tracking ID.

Fetches the e-EFKA clearance statement confirming a company's or individual's settled insurance dues, as issued through the accredited agents portal. Returns the generated PDF attestation with its verification code and issue date.
helper.upload_announcement_of_rental_of_: Auto-fills and submits the vessel charter notice forms (small craft and motorboat hire) on the user's behalf, then returns the upload status and reference number for each submitted form.
helper.upload_announcement_of_the_commen: Auto-fills and submits the regulatory notice forms for launching crop-protection chemical distribution, using the department's standard templates, then returns the submission receipt and reference ID.
helper.upload_announcement_of_the_operat: Submits domestic trade fair operation notices on behalf of the user: auto-fills the notification forms with event data and uploads them to the portal, returning the filing reference and status.
helper.upload_announcement_of_the_start_: Fills in and uploads the vessel-notification forms for a port reception facility ship entering service, using our internal form templates. Returns the submission ID and upload status for each completed form.
helper.upload_change_of_notification_of_: Auto-fills the amendment forms for a venue's operating notice (capacity, hours, licensed activities, premises details) and submits them to the authority portal, returning the submission reference and status.
helper.upload_copy_of_certificate_of_com: Fills in and uploads the instructor qualification paperwork for prospective powerboat handlers, returning a submission receipt with the reference ID and status of each filed form.
helper.upload_establishment_of_a_limited: Auto-fills and submits the registration forms for a new partnership entity via the agency's single-window intake, then returns the filing reference and status of each uploaded document.
helper.upload_establishment_of_a_soci_t_: Auto-completes and submits the registration paperwork for a new joint-stock company via the single-window portal, then returns the filing reference and status of each uploaded form.
helper.upload_notification_of_commenceme: Prepares and submits the start-up notification for a wine and aromatised wine bottling facility: fills the required forms with the operator's details and uploads them to the regulator's portal, returning the submission reference and status.
helper.upload_notification_of_operation_: Fills in and uploads the online forms for registering a rental business of motorcycles, tricycles and quadricycles above 50 cc (no driver included). Returns the submission status and reference number for the filed notification.
helper.upload_notification_of_the_operat: Fills in and submits the operator's registration forms for passenger tourism coach services, then returns the filing receipt and reference number.
helper.upload_renewal_of_a_licence_to_op: Auto-completes and submits the paperwork for a vessel operating permit extension for fast passenger boats, using our team's internal form templates, and returns the submission receipt and reference number.
helper.upload_myphoto_for_citizens: Auto-fills and submits citizen ID photo applications through the ThirdParty portal, returning the application reference number and submission status.
helper.upload_operating_licence_for_a_cn: Auto-completes and submits the CNG/mixed fuel station exploitation permit packet for concession holders: fills the department's standard form sets from supplied site and operator data, attaches the required annexes, and returns the submission receipt with a tracking reference.
ministry_of_comm.issue_a_commercial_regi: Submits a new company-formation filing to the MoC registry system and returns the intake reference number and current review status for the applicant's new business entity.
Generates the signed business establishment certificate for a newly registered company, returning the certificate PDF and its registry reference number from the MoC company database.
Charges the filing fee for a new business entity registration at the Commerce Ministry and returns the payment receipt reference and status.
ministry_of_muni.issuing_a_commercial_li: Submits a new trade permit request to the Balady ministry's business registry and returns the tracking reference for the filed application.
Generates the trade permit certificate for a business premises after validating the applicant's registration and zoning data, returning the signed PDF permit document with its reference number.
ministry_of_muni.issuing_a_fast_track_co: Submits a new trade-permit request to the Balady e-services portal for a business premises, registering the applicant's shop details and activity type, and returns the application reference number with its current processing status.

Generates the expedited business permit certificate for a shop or company, processed through the Balady IT backend. Returns the signed permit document (PDF reference and permit number) at the end of the workflow.
ministry_of_muni.renewing_a_commercial_l: Submits a renewal request for an existing trade permit via the Balady department's internal business-registry gateway, and returns the reference number and status of the filed case.
Regenerates a business trading permit for an existing establishment via the Balady portal and returns the signed renewal certificate with its expiry date and reference number.
ministry_of_muni.issuing_a_building_perm: Submits a new construction-authorization request to the Balady municipal e-services portal and returns the tracking reference for the filed case. Use it to lodge a fresh building-license dossier with the department, including applicant details, parcel data and attached drawings.

Generates the construction authorization certificate for a site once plan review and inspection sign-offs are complete, returning the signed permit document with its reference number. Internal name: BLD-CERT (Balady e-Permits).
ministry_of_muni.issuance_of_a_building_: Submits a new request through the Balady e-permit portal to obtain a final property use-readiness and regulatory-conformity clearance, and returns the application reference number and current review status.

Generates the final sign-off paper for a finished structure: fetches the inspection results, zoning-conformity flags and as-built plan references tied to a permit ID, then returns the completion permit PDF with its QR verification stamp. Internal dept. name: BLD-CLOSEOUT-SVC (Balady IT).
ministry_of_muni.issuance_of_a_health_ce: Submits a new food-handler medical clearance request for staff at food outlets, registering the applicant's details and returning a tracking reference number and the expected review status.

Generates the food handler clearance record for a staff member after the medical screening and hygiene course are verified in the Balady municipal system. Returns the signed PDF card with the worker's ID, validity date, and permit reference number.
Processes the payment of the fee for a food-handler sanitary clearance request at Balady. Returns the transaction receipt and status of the paid service.
ministry_of_muni.renewal_of_a_health_cer: Submits a new request to renew a food-establishment sanitary clearance through the Balady IT portal. Returns the request reference number, current status, and the expected inspection date.

Regenerates a valid food-handler medical clearance for staff at licensed establishments: submits the applicant's ID and lab screening results to the Balady portal and returns the renewed clearance PDF with its validity date.

Processes the payment for a food-handler medical clearance renewal at Balady's municipal health unit. Charges the applicable fee and returns the transaction receipt with reference number and payment status.
ministry_of_muni.issuance_of_a_seasonal_: Submits a new request in the Balady municipal licensing queue for a seasonal sanitary clearance, returning the application reference number and current review status for the food-handler or facility permit tracker.

Generates the Balady seasonal public-health clearance letter for food-handling and retail establishments: validates the operator's inspection record and returns the signed PDF permit ready for download.
ministry_of_muni.permit_for_24_hour_comm: Submits a new request to the Balady municipal licensing system for extended-hours trading operations, returning a tracking ID and the current review status of the filing.

Generates the round-the-clock trading license for storefronts and businesses via Balady's municipal licensing workflow; returns the signed extended-hours authorization certificate with its reference number.
ministry_of_muni.issuing_a_home_delivery: Submits a new request for home-delivery authorization through the Balady e-services gateway; accepts applicant ID, business premises details and delivery vehicle data, and returns a tracking reference number with the application status.

Generates the signed delivery authorization for a residential unit: pulls the applicant's property file and building inspection record from the Balady back-office, validates them, and returns the finalized release certificate as a PDF with its reference number.
general_director.safety_license_salama_p: Submits a new request or declaration to the Civil Defense Salama portal via the DGPC e-services gateway and returns the generated filing reference number and current review status.

Retrieves the fire-safety clearance certificate for a premises via the Salama portal, returning the issued certificate document for the applicant's site. Our IT team's internal name for it is "SafeClear-CD".
zakat_tax_and_cu.vat_registration_for_bu: Submits a new indirect-tax enrollment request for a business entity, collecting company identifiers, activity codes and turnover estimates, and returns the request reference number with the expected processing timeline.
Registers an entity in the indirect-tax ledger and returns the TIN-linked certificate confirming the taxable-supplier status issued by the ZTCA digital desk.
zakat_tax_and_cu.vat_registration_for_in: Submits a new indirect-levy enrollment request for a sole trader or natural person via the ZTCA portal, returning the enrollment reference number and the assigned taxpayer status once the file is accepted.

Submits an individual's sales-tax enrolment request and returns the issued VAT certificate with its assigned tax number and effective date. Developed by the ZATCA digital services team for the taxpayer-onboarding workflow.
zakat_tax_and_cu.vat_registration_for_a_: Submits a new group indirect-tax enrolment request for a consolidated taxpayer cluster, collecting the member entities and their primary business identifiers, and returns the batch reference number and onboarding status.
Submits a consolidated indirect-tax enrollment request for a corporate cluster under a single parent entity and returns the Tax Group Certificate issued at completion.
zakat_tax_and_cu.zakat_and_income_tax_re: Submits a new taxpayer onboarding request to the ZTCA e-filing gateway and returns the assigned filer reference number and onboarding status. Pulls entity details, activity codes and fiscal period from the applicant's profile to generate the registration record.

Retrieves the final certificate issued by the ZTCA onboarding workflow for taxpayer enrollment, covering the Zakat base and personal income levy obligations, returning the issued registration certificate and its reference number.
zakat_tax_and_cu.verify_vat_registration: Submits a taxpayer's VAT status check request to the ZTCA indirect-tax registry and returns the current registration record, including TRN, filing status, and effective date.

Checks a business's indirect-tax enrollment status and returns the official certificate confirming its active filer number and effective date, issued by the ZTCA finance systems team (Taxpayer Status Lookup).
zakat_tax_and_cu.update_vat_registration: Submits a change request to the VAT taxpayer master record, letting registered businesses amend their contact details, trading address, and bank account info, and returns a reference number with the processing status.

Modifies a taxpayer's VAT profile on file (business address, contact persons, bank account, authorized signatories) and returns the signed amendment confirmation certificate issued by the ZTCA Indirect Tax Records unit.
general_organiza.register_a_new_establis: Submits a new employer-site onboarding request to the GOSI portal, creating a fresh worksite record under the parent company account, and returns the assigned site reference number and submission status.

Onboards a new employer site into the social-insurance system and returns the issued enrollment certificate. Use it to create a fresh worksite or subsidiary record so payroll contributions can be linked to it.
ministry_of_huma.visa_issuance_for_an_es: Submits a new application for an establishment entry permit via the MoHRSD workforce portal and returns the tracking reference and current processing status.

Generates the signed entry-permit letter for a foreign worker's establishment placement, returning the authorization PDF with reference number, validity dates, and issuing officer seal. Built on the HR-Permits workflow ("Work Entry Permit Generator").
ministry_of_huma.employee_transfer_from_: Submits a new inbound staff move request (HR file intake for incoming personnel from an external employer) and returns the generated case reference number with the intake status.
Generates the staff move-in clearance certificate for MHRSD personnel, returning the signed confirmation issued once an incoming hire's prior-service and pension-record handover is complete.
general_director.renewal_of_residence_pe: Submits a fresh request on behalf of a resident to extend their stay credentials at the Jawazat, using the department's internal intake code. Returns a tracking reference, the case status, and the next required action or document list.

Fetches the final issued document from the Jawazat residency card extension workflow for a given applicant file, returning the stamped renewed resident card record (ID number, expiry date, and issuance status) for internal verification.
Settles the government fee for a residency card extension through the Passports Dept. e-gate; returns the payment receipt reference and the amount charged.
general_director.extension_of_an_exit_an: Submits a new request in the Jawazat case system to renew a temporary exit-and-return permit for a resident, then returns the generated case reference number and the current processing status.
Renews a traveler's temporary departure-and-return permit via the GDP Jawazat portal and returns the issued extension certificate (PDF) with its new validity date.
Settles the government fee for a re-entry permit renewal request via the Jawazat portal and returns the payment receipt reference and the amount charged.
general_director.final_exit_visa_sa24.su: Submits a new request to the Jawazat exit-permit desk for a departing traveler's clearance and returns the application reference number with its current processing status.
general_director.final_exit_visa_sa24.ge: Generates the exit-clearance certificate for residents leaving the country, issued by the Jawazat IT unit after the departure permit is approved, and returns the stamped clearance PDF with its reference number.
general_director.final_exit_visa_sa24.pa: Settles the fee for the outbound clearance permit via the passport directorate's payment gateway and returns the receipt reference and amount paid.
helper.upload_renewal_of_a_health_certif: Auto-completes and submits the ThirdParty medical clearance paperwork for an existing staff member: pulls the applicant's record, fills the health-clearance form fields, attaches supporting files, and returns the submission receipt with a tracking ID.
helper.upload_renewal_of_residence_permi: Auto-fills and submits the resident-ID extension forms via the TP portal, then returns the filing receipt and reference number for tracking.
